guidesAndTours.offerWalkthroughs: Offer walkthroughs when opening a view for the first time
guidesAndTours.title: Guides & tours

grouping.blurb: Drag one map instrument onto another to dock them into a shared card. Drag a member back out to free it, or scale the whole group at once.
grouping.title: Instrument grouping

mapSplit.blurb: The Split button on the map shares the panel with Vision. Drag the divider to set the size; the Pilot layout starts this way with synthetic vision.
mapSplit.title: Map and vision side by side

workspaceLayouts.blurb: The Workspace button switches between Pilot, FPV and Mission, each with its own panels, cockpit instruments and split. Save your own and share them as a file.
workspaceLayouts.title: Workspace layouts

sitl.title: Simulate before you fly
sitl.blurb: Open SITL from the rail, pick a vehicle and launch one simulator, or switch to Swarm to launch a fleet. ArduDeck downloads the firmware the first time and connects on its own.

crsf.title: Telemetry from an ExpressLRS backpack
crsf.blurb: Set the ELRS Telemetry Mode to WiFi, join the backpack network and connect with CRSF on port 14550. Works behind any CRSF receiver with nothing changed on the aircraft. For a two-way link, use MAVLink mode instead.

cargo.title: Add features with cargo
cargo.blurb: The Cargo Bay lists the cargo you can add: install, update or remove each one. Installed cargo brings its own views and cards into the app.

adjust.title: Adjust while flying
adjust.blurb: From the telemetry screen, change the target speed, altitude and loiter radius without leaving the flight view. A loiter radius change is shown for review before it is written.

language.title: ArduDeck speaks your language
language.blurb: Settings, Configuration, Language: English, Deutsch, 简体中文, 繁體中文 and Українська (beta). System follows your computer.
